research_question: Does a densely-connected CNN (DenseNet121) reach macro-F1 competitive with the Phase4/5 screened architectures (mobilenet_v3_small 0.695, resnet18 0.718, efficientnet_b0 0.729 mean valid macro-F1)?

Falsified if DenseNet121's mean macro-F1 mean is either >0.75 or <0.65 with non-overlapping seed ranges vs the existing 3.

secondary_dependent_variables: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, per-class F1, NLL/Brier/ECE pre+post calibration, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, params, checkpoint size, train time

dataset_split_and_leakage_controls: Existing fixed train/valid/test folders (2,821/310/557 images); validation split only for all selection; test split untouched by this family; NOT leakage-safe (41% of images are exact/near cross-split duplicates or label conflicts per outputs/phase5/deep/leakage_gate/leakage_report.json) -- results are development-only, not final
preprocessing_architecture_exceptions: None expected -- densenet121 has an ImageNet-pretrained torchvision backbone like the other 3; freeze_epochs=3 applies normally
secondary_metrics: Accuracy, balanced accuracy, ECE, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC
hyperparameter_search_space: None (reuses the frozen Phase4/5 protocol exactly -- this is a screening run, not a tuning run)
tuning_budget: Zero (no HP search) -- equal-budget with Phase4/5's own zero-HP-search screening
est_compute_time: ~550-750s/seed x3 = ~30-38 min total (extrapolated from resnet18/efficientnet_b0's real Phase4/5 wall-clock at the same param-count order of magnitude; not yet measured for densenet121)

est_storage: best.pt+last.pt ~170MB/seed x3 = ~0.51GB (12.1 bytes/param extrapolated from Phase5's real checkpoint-size/param-count ratio)
